title: Saint Sebastian Cathedral, Coronel Fabriciano

terrainReference.basis: Approximate forecourt paving outside the projecting east entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: The native cathedral polygon, parcel and Rua São Sebastião identify the modern co-cathedral in Santa Helena.

mapIdentity.scope: Native cathedral pentagon and Rua São Sebastião signed frontage. The parish identifies an east-facing triangular gable and three folded side bays.

note: The June 2010 Qualla view sets the broad painted concrete gable, orange edging, triangular upper light and narrow lower light, and the flat-roofed entry canopy.
